description: D1 /query corrections. (1) `d1_params` items accept any JSON scalar, not only strings: foundation_db binds integers, reals and NULL as JSON numbers and null. (2) `d1_query_meta` `changes` and `rows_written` are integers: they are SQLite row counts.
source: (1) The vendored spec types d1_params as an array of string. The local wrangler worker (worker-stub.js) binds JSON numbers and null through the D1 binding (checked 2026-11-02 with wrangler 4: null binds as NULL, a number as a number). That is the Worker binding, not Cloudflare's hosted REST endpoint, so the hosted endpoint is not proven by it; docs/bug-backlog.md tracks checking it with a real account. (2) D1 responses carry whole numbers for these two counters; the spec's `number` is looser than the wire.

items.description: One bound value: a JSON string, number, boolean or null.
